scope: Windows Desktop launch and same-session review/resume UI only; no model, provider or product file was changed during this audit
source_parity: The audited main repo and W14 worktree had byte-identical apps/desktop/main/main.js, workbench.html, preload/preload.js, main/lib/ipc.js, main/lib/v2.js, apps/web/src/continuity.jsx and internal/api/server.go.

real_entry.package: apps/desktop/package.json:6 declares main/main.js and pins electron 37.10.3
real_entry.smoke_result: Electron logged 'Attempted to register a second handler for ros:workspacePickDirectory' at apps/desktop/main/main.js:74 before boot() or ready_to_show. The smoke process stayed open because the 300 ms exit timer was never reached; it was interrupted and no matching Electron process remained.
real_entry.first_failure: apps/desktop/main/lib/ipc.js:98-100 registers ros:workspacePickDirectory through ipc.register(); apps/desktop/main/main.js:74 registers the same channel again.

source_to_ui_chain.if_boot_reached: apps/desktop/main/main.js:87 loads main/workbench.html via BrowserWindow.loadFile; it does not load apps/web/dist or a host URL.
source_to_ui_chain.static_renderer: workbench.html:54-103 invokes only flat window.researchos methods and renders a plain session list; it has no calls to window.researchos.v2 and no same-session event, artifact, attach or handoff controls.
source_to_ui_chain.typed_bridge: preload/preload.js:17-33 declares all 23 v2 methods on window.researchos.v2; main/lib/ipc.js:59-91 routes each to main/lib/v2.js POST /v2/command; internal/api/server.go:59 serves that endpoint. The bridge exists but is not called from the actually loaded renderer.
source_to_ui_chain.web_only_review: apps/web/src/main.jsx:14,22 and screens.jsx:215 route /p/<project>/continuity to apps/web/src/continuity.jsx, where session.get/events/attach/handoff and explicit RESUME controls exist. The Electron window does not load this React route.
source_to_ui_chain.legacy_routes: main/lib/host.js:19 maps flat session methods to /sessions and /sessions/send; internal/api/server.go:32-65 registers /healthz, /v1/, /v2/command and static files, with no /sessions route.

other_launch_breaks_after_first_failure: main/main.js:15 computes ROOT as <repo>/apps; :85 then points preload at <repo>/apps/preload/preload.js, which does not exist.
main/main.js:16-17 computes discovery/principal two levels above <repo>/apps, not <repo>/.local; a Node path resolution in the W14 worktree confirmed both wrong destinations.
main/main.js:26 uses a placeholder executable when RESEARCHOS_CONTROL_EXE is absent; when present it appends --serve, but apps/control/main.go:40-50 defines no --serve flag.

Both main and W14 worktree commands.json mark desktop.shell_launch UNBOUND. In the worktree apps/web/dist/index.html and the wrongly resolved discovery file are absent; the main repo discovery file exists but its 127.0.0.1:18923 health endpoint refused connection during this audit.
conclusion: The currently shipped Electron process cannot reach the same-session review screen. This is a measured startup failure plus a source-to-UI wiring gap, not a W14 acceptance result.
